name: Litigation Committee Liaison Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
Beverly Hills City Council Liaison I Litigation Committee will conduct
  a Special Meeting, at the following time and place, and will address
  the agenda listed below:

  CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 N. Rexford Drive
  4th
  Floor Conference Room A
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210

  Monday, March 31, 2025
  5:00 PM

  AGENDA

  1) Public Comment
  a.  Members of the public will be given the opportunity to directly address the
  Committee on any item listed on the agenda

  2) Annual Insurance Renewal Discussion

  3) Outside Counsel Request for Rate Increase  —  Walsworth

  CLOSED SESSION:

  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL The City Council finds, based on advice from legal
  counsel, that discussion in open session will prejudice the position of the local agency in the
  litigation.

  4) Existing Litigation: Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(1) Name of Case:

  Martha Fox v. City of Beverly Hills, et al., Los Angeles Superior Court Case No.21 STCVI 3446

  This litigation concerns a trip and fall accident that occurred at or near the alleyway located
  at 404 North Palm Drive.

  Albert Massachi, et al. v. City of Beverly Hills, et al., Los Angeles Superior Court Case
  No. I9SMCVOO133 consolidated with Los Angeles Superior Court Case No. 19STCV09726

  This litigation concerns a tree that fell, resulting in property damage.

  5) Adjournment

Huma Ahmed
City Clerk

Posted: March 28, 2025

 Pursuant to the Americans with Disabilities Act, the City of Beverly Hills will make reasonable efforts to
  accommodate persons with disabilities. If you require special assistance, please call (310) 285-1014
  (voice) or (310) 285-6881 (TTY). Providing at least twenty-four (24) hours advance notice will help to
  ensure availability of services. City Hall, including the 4th Floor Conference Room A, is wheelchair
  accessible.
